cite.text: FullPAC, Inc. · S-1/A filed Sep 18, 2026 · Six months ended Jun 30, 2026

analysis: Revenue was $1.3M in H1 2026, up 450% year over year.

Gross margin was 62.4%, down 0.2 points from H1 2025. Operating costs exceeded revenue by $2.3M, an operating margin of -176.8%. Operating expenses grew 686% against revenue growth of 450%. The fastest-growing cost line was Research & development (+2972%). The period ended with a net loss of $5.6M. Net interest and other expense of $3.3M was the main reason.

Operating cash flow was −$1.7M. Non-cash charges added back $34K of depreciation and amortization. Working capital and other items added $3.9M. Capital expenditures of $1K exceeded it, leaving free cash flow of −$1.7M.
